comment: Inputs 1 and 2 (phase and reset) are declared in the shared DivBase code but no jack is added for either on this panel, so neither gets a line or a tag; the reset instead arrives over the bus from whichever module is being followed. The bus is a leftExpander/rightExpander message carrying four phases at once, one slot each for Clock, Divider, Div and Div (Expander) (Clock.cpp:3-23), which is why the menu can pick a module that is not the immediate neighbour.
